display.purpose: Responsive landing hero headline in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next.

body.purpose: Chat, controls, and explanatory copy use Atkinson Hyperlegible Next.

code.purpose: System monospace for short code, timestamps, thresholds, and tabular figures.

shadows.name: showcase-chat
shadows.purpose: Separates the landing-page chat demonstration from its surrounding stage.

shadows.name: floating-menu
shadows.purpose: Elevates an open dashboard status menu above the work area.

shadows.name: obs-card
shadows.purpose: Separates the OBS card from arbitrary video content behind its transparent document.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Subtle hover/active feedback on landing controls.

motion.name: message-action-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveals dashboard message actions on hover or focus; actions stay visible on touch.

motion.name: overlay-enter
motion.purpose: Short entrance for the OBS card.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; use near-instant overlay animation and disable smooth chat scrolling

components.name: Primary Operator Button
components.description: Compact purple primary action used in the operational UI.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--dracula-purple); color: var(--dracula-background); font: 700 13px var(--font); cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: var(--dracula-subtle); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--dracula-purple); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Landing CTA
components.description: Orange, high-emphasis install/playground action on the public landing page.
components.css: .ds-landing-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--dracula-orange); color: var(--dracula-background); font: 600 16px var(--font); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-landing-cta:hover { background: var(--dracula-orange); } .ds-landing-cta:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-landing-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--dracula-purple); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled operator input with a dark fill and visible focus outline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--dracula-muted); font: 700 13px var(--font); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(98 114 164 / 46%); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--dracula-background); color: var(--dracula-foreground); font: 400 15px / 1.45 var(--font); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--dracula-purple); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Navigation Item
components.description: Stable dashboard rail item with a purple selected marker and a labeled destination.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 9px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--dracula-selection); color: var(--dracula-foreground); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--dracula-purple); font: 700 15px var(--font); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--dracula-floating); color: var(--dracula-foreground); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--dracula-purple); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Review Status Chip
components.description: Outlined review label; the written state remains visible in addition to its color.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; padding: 1px 8px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--dracula-orange); font: 400 13px var(--font); }

components.name: Operator Panel
components.description: Flat grouping surface for related dashboard controls and readings.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(98 114 164 / 46%); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--dracula-floating); color: var(--dracula-foreground); font: 400 15px / 1.45 var(--font); } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 700 24px / 1.2 var(--font); } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--dracula-muted); }

components.name: Review Message Row
components.description: Chat row marked for human review with a restrained orange tint and leading rule.
components.css: .ds-message-review { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 12px; align-items: start; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; background: rgb(255 184 108 / 14%); box-shadow: inset 1px 0 0 var(--dracula-orange); color: var(--dracula-foreground); font: 400 15px / 1.45 var(--font); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-message-review .ds-status-chip { border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 8px; color: var(--dracula-orange); font-size: 13px; }

components.name: OBS Overlay Card
components.description: Dracula floating card over a transparent OBS document, with a thin accent edge.
components.css: .ds-overlay-card { max-width: min(640px, 100%); padding: 18px 22px 20px; border: 1px solid rgb(98 114 164 / 42%); border-top: 2px solid var(--dracula-cyan); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--dracula-floating); color: var(--dracula-foreground); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgb(25 26 33 / 72%); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-overlay-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-overlay-label { padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--dracula-purple); color: var(--dracula-background); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-overlay-author { color: var(--dracula-muted); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-overlay-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

narrative.overview:
Vigia uses Dracula Classic as a precise, readable working palette rather than a decorative neon effect. Its visual grammar borrows the stable slots and numeric clarity of a broadcast scoreboard so moderation states, reasons, and controls remain easy to scan while a stream is live.

Each surface keeps its own task and affordances: the landing page demonstrates the existing chat decision flow, the playground pairs controls with a bounded chat replay, and the dashboard, setup/login, and OBS overlay remain operational. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next carries UI text; system monospace is reserved for short code and numerals. The existing bat emoji remains the product mark.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only Dracula Classic palette with stable, semantic color assignments.
Flat tonal surfaces, thin blue-gray separators, and restrained depth.
Explicit text labels accompany colored moderation states.
Surface-specific responsive layouts preserve controls and reading order.

rules.name: The Labeled-State Rule
rules.body: Color reinforces a state but never carries it alone; retain the explicit state label and any existing icon or rule marker.

rules.name: The Reading-First Rule
rules.body: Keep messages and explanatory copy in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next; reserve monospace for short technical or numeric values.

rules.name: The Structural-Depth Rule
rules.body: Prefer tonal surface changes and borders at rest; use shadows only where a layer actually floats or is being presented.

dos: Do keep the Dracula Classic color roles stable across landing, playground, dashboard, setup/login, and overlay.
Do accompany status colors with explicit text and preserve visible keyboard focus.
Do use Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for UI and system monospace for short code and numerals.
Do keep the OBS document transparent and style only its floating card.
Do retain the existing bat emoji as Vigia's mark.
donts: Don't introduce light mode, system-preference light surfaces, neon glow, glass, gradients, or pixel fonts.
Don't rely on color alone for moderation states or use current-line as small reading text.
Don't reveal spoiler-marked message text by default.
Don't replace the bat mark or redesign it as part of a visual-system extension.
